{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module SearchIndex where

import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Time.Clock
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Control.Exception (catch)
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T

-- Circuit Breaker States
data CBState = Closed | Open | HalfOpen deriving (Show, Eq)

data CircuitBreaker = CircuitBreaker
  { cbState       :: IORef CBState
  , cbFailures    :: IORef Int
  , cbLastFailure :: IORef UTCTime
  , cbThreshold   :: Int
  , cbTimeout     :: NominalDiffTime
  }

data IndexEntry = IndexEntry
  { entryScore    :: Double
  , entryPayload  :: Text
  , entryVersion  :: Int
  } deriving (Show)

data SearchIndex = SearchIndex
  { siEntries     :: MVar (Map Text IndexEntry)
  , siBreaker     :: CircuitBreaker
  , siQuotaUsed   :: MVar Int
  , siQuotaLimit  :: Int
  , siFlashWindow :: IORef UTCTime
  , siWindowOps   :: IORef Int
  }

newCircuitBreaker :: Int -> NominalDiffTime -> IO CircuitBreaker
newCircuitBreaker threshold timeout = do
  st <- newIORef Closed
  fc <- newIORef 0
  lt <- getCurrentTime >>= newIORef
  return $ CircuitBreaker st fc lt threshold timeout

newSearchIndex :: Int -> IO SearchIndex
newSearchIndex quota = do
  entries <- newMVar Map.empty
  cb <- newCircuitBreaker 5 30
  qu <- newMVar 0
  fw <- getCurrentTime >>= newIORef
  wo <- newIORef 0
  return $ SearchIndex entries cb qu quota fw wo

-- Rate limiting: operations per time window
checkRateLimit :: SearchIndex -> IO Bool
checkRateLimit si = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  windowStart <- readIORef (siFlashWindow si)
  let elapsed = diffUTCTime now windowStart
  if elapsed > 1.0  -- 1 second window
    then do
      writeIORef (siFlashWindow si) now
      writeIORef (siWindowOps si) 0
      return True
    else do
      ops <- readIORef (siWindowOps si)
      -- Allow burst of operations within window
      return (ops < 100)

-- Record operation for rate limiting
recordOp :: SearchIndex -> IO ()
recordOp si = modifyIORef' (siWindowOps si) (+1)

-- Check circuit breaker allows operation
withCircuitBreaker :: CircuitBreaker -> IO a -> IO (Either String a)
withCircuitBreaker cb action = do
  state <- readIORef (cbState cb)
  case state of
    Open -> do
      now <- getCurrentTime
      lastFail <- readIORef (cbLastFailure cb)
      if diffUTCTime now lastFail > cbTimeout cb
        then do
          writeIORef (cbState cb) HalfOpen
          tryAction cb action
        else return $ Left "Circuit breaker is open"
    _ -> tryAction cb action

tryAction :: CircuitBreaker -> IO a -> IO (Either String a)
tryAction cb action = do
  result <- (Right <$> action) `catch` (\e -> return $ Left (show (e :: IOError)))
  case result of
    Right val -> do
      writeIORef (cbFailures cb) 0
      writeIORef (cbState cb) Closed
      return $ Right val
    Left err -> do
      modifyIORef' (cbFailures cb) (+1)
      failures <- readIORef (cbFailures cb)
      when (failures >= cbThreshold cb) $ do
        writeIORef (cbState cb) Open
        getCurrentTime >>= writeIORef (cbLastFailure cb)
      return $ Left err

-- Batch index operation - atomic quota reservation
batchIndex :: SearchIndex -> [(Text, IndexEntry)] -> IO (Either String Int)
batchIndex si items = do
  allowed <- checkRateLimit si
  if not allowed
    then return $ Left "Rate limited"
    else do
      let batchSize = length items

      -- Atomically reserve quota BEFORE performing operations
      -- Uses MVar to ensure mutual exclusion on quota check+update
      reserveResult <- modifyMVar (siQuotaUsed si) $ \currentQuota -> do
        let projectedUsage = currentQuota + batchSize
        if projectedUsage <= siQuotaLimit si
          then return (projectedUsage, Right ())
          else return (currentQuota, Left "Quota exceeded")

      case reserveResult of
        Left err -> return $ Left err
        Right () -> do
          -- Quota already reserved atomically, now perform operations
          result <- withCircuitBreaker (siBreaker si) $ do
            modifyMVar_ (siEntries si) $ \m -> do
              let m' = foldl (\acc (k,v) -> Map.insert k v acc) m items
              return m'
            return batchSize

          case result of
            Right n -> do
              recordOp si
              return $ Right n
            Left err -> do
              -- Rollback quota on failure
              modifyMVar_ (siQuotaUsed si) $ \q -> return (q - batchSize)
              return $ Left err

-- Single document index
indexDocument :: SearchIndex -> Text -> IndexEntry -> IO (Either String ())
indexDocument si key entry = do
  allowed <- checkRateLimit si
  if not allowed
    then return $ Left "Rate limited"
    else do
      reserveResult <- modifyMVar (siQuotaUsed si) $ \quota ->
        if quota >= siQuotaLimit si
          then return (quota, Left "Quota exceeded")
          else return (quota + 1, Right ())
      case reserveResult of
        Left err -> return $ Left err
        Right () -> do
          result <- withCircuitBreaker (siBreaker si) $ do
            modifyMVar_ (siEntries si) $ \m ->
              return $ Map.insert key entry m
          case result of
            Right _ -> do
              recordOp si
              return $ Right ()
            Left err -> do
              modifyMVar_ (siQuotaUsed si) $ \q -> return (q - 1)
              return $ Left err

-- Search operation
searchIndex :: SearchIndex -> Text -> IO (Either String [IndexEntry])
searchIndex si query = do
  withCircuitBreaker (siBreaker si) $ do
    entries <- readMVar (siEntries si)
    let results = Map.elems $ Map.filterWithKey
          (\k _ -> query `T.isInfixOf` k) entries
    return results

-- Reset quota (admin operation)
resetQuota :: SearchIndex -> IO ()
resetQuota si = modifyMVar_ (siQuotaUsed si) $ \_ -> return 0
